title: AWS CloudTrail Baseline Ingestion and Health

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `aws:cloudtrail` events matching `*` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.1.78 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudtrail` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:cloudtrail` collected via Splunk Add-on for AWS (`Splunk_TA_aws`, Splunkbase 1876); validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.78_aws_cloudtrail_baseline_78"
| sort -_time
description: Verifies that AWS CloudTrail management events are flowing into Splunk via the AWS add-on, with recent events across regions and no prolonged ingestion gaps that would blind security monitoring.
value: CloudTrail is the foundational audit plane for every other AWS detection in this catalog. Without continuous, multi-region CloudTrail ingestion, IAM, network, and data-plane changes become invisible until an incident or audit reveals the gap.
implementation: Enable an organization trail or account-level trails in all active regions. Configure `Splunk_TA_aws` CloudTrail input (S3 bucket or CloudWatch Logs subscription). Alert when no events arrive for 60 minutes during business hours.
visualization: Single value (events last 24h), ingestion lag chart, region coverage matrix.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for AWS (`Splunk_TA_aws`, Splunkbase 1876) with the modular input for `aws:cloudtrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): none.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable an organization trail or account-level trails in all active regions. Configure `Splunk_TA_aws` CloudTrail input (S3 bucket or CloudWatch Logs subscription). Alert when no events arrive for 60 minutes during business hours.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress awsRegion
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.78_aws_cloudtrail_baseline_78"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudtrail` in `index=aws` to detect aws cloudtrail baseline ingestion and health. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS CloudTrail console Event history for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_1_78_alert` with severity aligned to `critical` criticality. Dashboard: Single value (events last 24h), ingestion lag chart, region coverage matrix..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for AWS (`Splunk_TA_aws`, Splunkbase 1876) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of aws cloudtrail baseline ingestion and health so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
